newsitem.title: USA: XOMA says Phase II Neuprex results positive.
newsitem.headline: XOMA says Phase II Neuprex results positive.

text.p: XOMA Corp on Thursday said its 400-patient Phase II trial of Neuprex reduced serious complications in patients suffering from acute losses of blood, a condition known as hemorrhagic trauma.
When measured against a placebo, Neuprex cut the numbers of organ dysfunction, infections and death, and the product was shown to be safe.
"We are very confident that the results support advancing to Phase III," Jack Castello, chairman, said in a statement.
XOMA said it plans to publish detailed test data, and it is working to schedule an end-of-Phase II FDA meeting.
